why_prior_sweeps_missed: Layout and structure audits measured density, hierarchy, and resident-serving actions in the opening viewport. They did not ask whether Property Disposition notices answer a surplus-goods buyer's ordered questions (what / how much / deal? / how to bid) from unstructured notice bodies. Capability coverage was invisible to density metrics.

questions: WHAT is being sold (item category + quantity)?
HOW MUCH (labeled minimum bid / upset / appraisal)?
Is it a DEAL (discount vs stated value when both publish)?
When / how do I bid (sale method + participation steps)?

vehicle + min bid + appraisal → deal signal 40% of stated appraised value
